rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and zip, matched to a single user via tools, then proceeded only on that user’s account. It listed recent orders after the user asked, confirmed the exact address change for both pending orders before making any writes, and successfully updated both orders’ shipping addresses as confirmed by tool outputs. For the jigsaw change, the agent confirmed intent and payment method first, checked product variants, selected the lowest-piece beginner option available, performed the modification on the pending order, and accurately reported that a refund to PayPal was issued, consistent with tool results. All information given aligns with tool data, no unauthorized actions were taken, and no writes occurred without prior confirmation. While the user’s profile address was not updated, the user did not request that explicitly; the agent fulfilled all expressed requests in line with policy.
